issues.title: PVOS-301 — Runtime Input Contract
issues.objective: Define the bounded PVOS Runtime input contract without changing Product Scope or creating a new Product model.
scope: Review and define the existing Project Data Boundary for one deterministic layout operation
Define the existing Module Parameters boundary
Define the existing Layout Parameters boundary
Define the Validation Input Contract and required input evidence
out_of_scope: Product Scope, Product Blueprint, Capability status, EOS, or Governance changes
Canonical Project Model or Legacy Asset promotion
Runtime JSON, UI, Cloud, full AutoCAD integration, Electrical, Construction, or PVOS 2.x implementation
acceptance_criteria: Input structure, Project Data Boundary, Module Parameters, Layout Parameters, and validation inputs are explicit
Every input maps to an existing Product capability and current C# Mainline boundary
No new serialization contract, Product model, or Product Scope is introduced
required_evidence: Existing asset inspection and input field inventory

issues.title: PVOS-302 — Runtime Execution Workflow
issues.objective: Define the repeatable engineer execution workflow for the existing C# PVOS Runtime.
scope: Define the Execution Entry and prerequisites
Define bounded Error Handling and blocker dispositions
Define Result Handling and transfer to presentation and validation evidence
out_of_scope: New Runtime engine, orchestration service, UI, Cloud, or network API
Full AutoCAD integration, Electrical, Construction, or PVOS 2.x work
Product Scope, EOS, Governance, or Legacy Asset promotion
acceptance_criteria: Execution entry, actors, prerequisites, ordered steps, and terminal states are unambiguous
Errors, valid no-fit warnings, environment blockers, and successful results remain distinguishable
The C# Core → Layout → CLI Mainline remains authoritative
required_evidence: Existing build, tests, CLI, and Golden Dataset references

issues.title: PVOS-303 — Runtime Result Presentation Boundary
issues.objective: Define the deterministic Product integrity boundary between Runtime results, presentation, and evidence output.
scope: Define Result Presentation Rules for existing LayoutResult fields
Define Evidence Output Rules and traceability
Require presentation to preserve Runtime ordering, identifiers, warnings, and errors
Prohibit presentation from recalculating placement or Product summary values
out_of_scope: UI implementation, rendering framework, interaction design, or delivery channel
New placement, optimization, or result-calculation behavior
Cloud, full AutoCAD integration, Electrical, Construction, PVOS 2.x, Product Scope, EOS, or Governance changes
acceptance_criteria: Every presented Product field traces to LayoutResult or immutable validation metadata
Presentation does not move, filter, score, or recalculate placement
Presentation does not recalculate count, installed capacity, warnings, or errors

issues.title: PVOS-304 — Runtime Acceptance Criteria
issues.objective: Establish the evidence-gated Runtime Acceptance framework for PM review.
scope: Define Runtime Validation Criteria for input, execution, results, and presentation
Define deterministic Regression Requirements against the Golden Dataset
Define Evidence Requirements, result semantics, and PM acceptance gate
Preserve item-level PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, and NOT RUN dispositions
out_of_scope: Executor self-acceptance or automatic Product acceptance
UI, Cloud, full AutoCAD integration, Electrical, Construction, or PVOS 2.x development
Product Scope, EOS, Governance, Capability status, release allocation, or Legacy Asset promotion
acceptance_criteria: Every Runtime criterion has a validation method, expected result, required evidence, and PM gate
Regression requires immutable commit identity, C# tests, CLI execution, and Golden Dataset evidence
PASS remains evidence for PM review and does not perform Product Acceptance
required_evidence: Scope-integrity verification and PM review record requirements
